scripts.db:verify:local: pnpm db:migrate:local && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name IN ('institutions', 'idempotency_records', 'outbox_events', 'audit_events', 'background_tasks') ORDER BY name; SELECT COUNT(*) AS audit_trigger_count FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'trigger' AND name IN ('audit_events_no_update', 'audit_events_no_delete'); SELECT COUNT(*) AS institution_count FROM institutions; SELECT COUNT(*) AS idempotency_count FROM idempotency_records; SELECT COUNT(*) AS outbox_count FROM outbox_events; SELECT COUNT(*) AS audit_count FROM audit_events; SELECT COUNT(*) AS background_task_count FROM background_tasks;"
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
